criteria.text: Exact image/source/ABI/dependencies proven; incompatible module refused.
LKM sole authority; Bash has no state/filesystem fallback.
One event per supported observable boot; repeat starts/reloads do not duplicate.
Exclusive create and empty inode+directory sync precede reason write.
Storage faults continue boot with bounded retry and no duplicate.
Filename, UTC filter, collision, invalid clock, empty-file semantics exact.
Root-only bounded protocol rejects malformed/dead sessions safely.
Count/reset preserve unrelated/unsafe files and report partial errors.
Single reversible DEB preserves first baseline through lifecycle.
Remove/purge restore without reboot; busy unload remains pending.
Continuous image lock and quarantine enforced.
Managed paths restored; source image hash unchanged.
Physical SRC/durability gaps remain explicit until HW evidence.
No kernel/MONIT/cron/USB changes, daemon, or automatic reboot.
